result_preview.description: Synthesizes engineering change records, material master data, and product item configurations to aggregate supply chain costs, bill of materials complexity, and regulatory compliance exposure. Provides metrics on supplier dependencies, cost variance trends, and compliance risk implications for product portfolio decisions in sales planning.

result_preview.description: Aggregates contract lifecycle data, purchase order fulfillment patterns, and vendor adherence to compliance standards to provide comprehensive procurement governance insights. Summarizes contract performance indicators, PO-to-contract alignment metrics, and vendor regulatory compliance status. Provides metrics on procurement risk exposure, contract utilization rates, and vendor compliance trends across sourcing initiatives.

result_preview.title: Procurement Spend Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated spend metrics and vendor performance trends across purchase orders and contracts.
result_preview.description: A derived analytical data product that consolidates procurement spend data across vendors, purchase orders, and active contracts. It provides pre-calculated KPIs including category spend distribution, vendor spend concentration, contract utilization rates, and period-over-period spend variance. This product enables procurement teams to identify optimization opportunities, monitor vendor performance, and support strategic sourcing decisions.
